timeline.text: Walking past the kitchen TV, you saw one screen — tasks, or a lock screen — never who's home, never what's on this week.
The camera feed, when it showed up at all, got cropped into whatever odd shape was left over.
Now a Cloudflare Worker feeds a calendar strip and a live camera tile alongside the same screen, scaled down instead of redrawn.
One glance at the TV now shows four things at once instead of one.
